entities.name: Roque Barcia Martí
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Roque Barcia Martí was a Spanish writer and republican politician belonging first to the Democratic Party and then, during the Sexenio Democrático, to the Republican Federal Party. He served as a deputy in the Cortes in 1869, 1871, and 1873, as a senator in 1872, and was a leading figure in the Cantón de Cartagena uprising.
